senses.gloss:
वैपथक वैपथक, अस्, आ, or ई, अम् (fr. वि-
पथ), relating to a wrong path, going wrong,
devious.

वैपरीत्य वैपरीत्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-परीत),
contrariety, opposition, adverseness, reverse; counter-
part.
—वैपरीत्य-लज्जालु, उस्, m. f. a particular
species of sensitive plant or Mimosa Pudica (small
in size but bearing large seed or fruit).
—वैपरीत्य-
सम्बन्ध, अस्, m. the relation of contrariety or
contradictoriness.

वैपुल्य वैपुल्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-पुल), large-
ness, spaciousness, abundance, plenty.
